notes.title: 💡 Let's feature your stream on Next Fest!
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is going to run from June 13th to the 20th. I have to possibility to stream the game in two highlighted spots, but I am not a big streamer myself. So I would like to offer this nice spot with possibly very good visibility to mostly upcoming streamers, but veterans are also welcome to participate. Hopefully it is going to be beneficial for the streamers and the game as well. 

[previewyoutube=hsbKEZyAb1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

If you are game follow this path:

1 - Download the free demo from Steam (Oculus and Index is suppprted at the moment) https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594690/Mayhem_on_a_Rainbow__VR/

2 - Stream the game on any channel you usually stream on, be it Twitch, Youtube, Twitter or anything else.

3 - Rules of streaming: audio commentary is a necessary to participate in this endeavour, please be family friendly as much as possible

4 - Fill out the submission form: https://forms.gle/56mDJ2wWSKzbWBui7

5 - Join the game's discord server, hit me up, and I will add you to a closed channel where we will discuss the details of this adventure https://discord.com/invite/twdrUjRvZz

6 - I will select streams to include in the Next Fest Stream based on their quality and fun level

7 - Everyone who gets into the final selection will get a free key to the full release and to beta testing.

8 - If you can please record your stream and also upload it to google drive or wetransfer or similar for me to access it a bit more easily

9 - By submitting your stream you agree to it being used in its entirety or in parts on the games youtube channel and on it's Steam page. You confirm that the submitted stream is your creation and you have every right to share it. You ofcourse have the possibility to cancel your submission, but you also realize that it might take time for me to pull it from the internets if I can at all considering the nature of the interweb.

Thank you very much!
Have a lovely day!
Lumi Finley


The streamer in the video is Rex Strider.
Follow Rex Strider:
TWITCH: https://www.twitch.tv/rexstrider
TWITTER: https://twitter.com/RexStrider
INDIE GAME COLLECTIVE: https://beacons.ai/indiegamecollective

notes.title: Public Demo v3 - updates
notes.content:
NEW FEATURES
- Unlocked the level The Last Taxi, this is going to be a story mission, it is still beta, but I wanted to let you ride the horse. :)
- Added a new level for the tutorial as an homage 
- Revamped the Break Saber level, to be darker with little zombie torches, also added a default weapon to it.
- new saber
PATCH NOTES
- switched up spaceship controls (tester request)
- fixed SA2RA rotation in the spaceboat
- thumbnail images at game start menu
- flying into Earth will start a mission
- there should be really only one, armored knight coming at a time 
- there is a lot of things happening under the hood, will show them to you in a new trailer soon.

notes.title: Key art evolution!
notes.content:
I’ve spent the last 1-1,5 years developing this game. Today I probably managed to finalize the key art for it. It also changed it's name since the first tries :) In the end I went with featuring the main character, SA-2RA (after the player), because she is going to be the one visible at all. I hope it is to your liking :)

Have a lovely day,
Lumi

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
- I have added an option to select an external camera for the pc screen. It might be fun when playing among friends or for streaming purposes, but be aware it is going to affect performance as it is going to render a third screen next to the two eyes, so be careful with it, and tune the graphics setting if necessary to maintain optimal performance. Update your demo and try it! Send us some lovely screen captures to screenshots-and-captures 
- fixed some occasionally typos 
- fixed window focusing issues when run from Oculus Virtual Desktop 
- deleted the close button from the tutorial level, also added a little note about gun rotation there
-I have added Mr. and Mrs. Bat to the weapons, they are also available in the demo, so update the game and take them for a spin!

notes.title: Community Question: Recoils in VR?
notes.content:
Hey Folks, 
what do you think about recoils in VR? It adds a lot to the overall feeling of the gun but when does it get annoying? Should it build gradually up to an uncontrollable level or it should be more like a static kicking? For me it kind of feels a bit like realism vs fun. Where is the sweetspot for you?

Feel free to answer here or join our Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/twdrUjRvZz

Have a lovely day! 
Best wishes, 
Lumi
